respuesta.pregunta: In demand-forecast-docs latest, I ran poetry install and now want to import the pipelines from the project's main module. What's the right import path: marketplace.pipes.main or app.pipes.main?
respuesta.respuesta: The documentation doesn't agree with itself here, so I can't tell you which path is correct. It says that after `poetry install` you can import the modules in the `src/` folder the same way you would import a normal package [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L101-L101]. The example for the marketplace project then imports `from marketplace.pipes.main import pipelines` [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L104-L106]. But the sentence right after that example says `app.pipes.main` is the module inside the project's `src/` [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L108-L108], which doesn't match the package name the code just used. With only this documentation I can't say whether the module is under `marketplace` or under `app`. Checking which package actually exists in your `src/` directory would settle it.
